source_notes: Main p.2 reports 20 nmol starting CdSe for all diameters, methanol 3 mL, 7000 rpm 5 min, 1.1 mL toluene plus 6 mL 9-ACA 3:11 acetonitrile/toluene, 12 h stirring, acetone twice solution volume, then 7830 rpm 15 min.
The stated 0.0216 M is described as both final concentration and solubility limit of 9-ACA in the mixed solvent; concentration after adding 1.1 mL toluene cannot be uniquely inferred.
Table 1 uses 1.7 mM DPA and 488/532 nm assays; Figure 2 uses 2.15 mM DPA, and Figure 3 uses 1 mM. These are different optical contexts, not changes to the nanocrystal growth recipe.
SI Table S2 reports 9-ACA saturation in eight solvents. These are solvent reference measurements, not eight new synthesis–structure pairs.
The source reports seven CdSe nominal diameters and wurtzite phase but no TEM image, particle-shape assignment, lattice refinement or source-measured atomic coordinates.

SI p.1 Materials lists dry and degassed acetone, toluene, and hexane supplied by a solvent-purification system. It does not establish dry/degassed methanol or acetonitrile, nor handling of each withdrawn aliquot.

evidence_conflicts.main: Main p.3 describes around 0.1 9-ACA/nm² as a broad statement.
evidence_conflicts.si: SI p.2 Table S1 separately reports 0.090–1.128 9-ACA/nm²; 2.7 nm row is 1.128/nm².
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Display both, do not replace the table or silently average.

evidence_conflicts.main: Main p.4 Table 1 and Fig.4 label a 3.7 nm CdSe row.
evidence_conflicts.si: SI p.2 Table S1 labels a 3.8 nm NMR row.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Do not assign the SI 3.8 nm ligand density to main 3.7 nm optical record without source crosswalk.

evidence_conflicts.topic: 2.7 nm CdSe PLQY differs between Table 1 and source-figure legends
evidence_conflicts.main: Main p.4 Table 1 lists 11.0% for nominal 2.7 nm CdSe; main p.3 Figure 4a visible legend labels 11.2% for 2.7 nm.
evidence_conflicts.si: SI p.4 Figure S2 visible legend also labels 11.2% for 2.7 nm.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Display 11.0% table value and 11.2% figure-legend value side by side; do not select an undocumented correction or infer separate physical batch identity.

remaining_gaps: Actual CdSe core-synthesis reagent amounts/temperatures are not in the main or matched SI; only a Carbone et al. 2007 hot-injection citation is supplied.
Source does not state size measurement technique or post-exchange size confirmation.
Ligand exchange temperature, individual 9-ACA stock charges, and effective final concentration after extra toluene are unresolved.
No source-assigned TEM morphology, measured atomistic structure, or physical vial IDs.
9-ACA and DPA are shown with source-backed 2D connectivity cards only; no valid rotatable 3D conformer was generated from this source.
training_note: Seven nominal-size variants support scoped ligand-exchange recipe–reported-size pairs. Do not treat the pre-existing CdSe core-growth recipe as fully specified, or infer exact sample atomic coordinates. Separate optical-assay DPA concentrations and solvent series from synthesis inputs.
